name: Agribio Spirits Limited
summary: Established in 1975 and headquartered in Kolkata, India, Agribio Spirits Limited is primarily involved in the domestic trading of various commodities. The company also operates an export division specializing in products like leather, jute, and artisanal handicrafts. Previously known as Beekay Niryat Limited, the organization officially adopted its current name, Agribio Spirits Limited, in November 2024.
